title: Fetch native lane tips through an advertised ref
body: A fresh NTFS clone rejected git fetch /home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/vxtrain8 389b6645 with 'couldn't find remote ref 389b6645'. Fetching the advertised lane-vxtrain8 branch from the same worktree succeeded and produced the identical detached tip. Make the native-checkout recipe fetch the source branch ref (or otherwise advertise the tip) so the documented SHA-based command works on fresh clones.

title: Add native Windows registration for device-loss recovery
body: The native MSVC preset configured VIXEN_FAIL_SCENARIOS=ON and the final recovery build succeeded, but CTest found no vixen_device_loss_recovery test. The only registration is inside the BUILD_TESTS AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL Linux branch in VIXEN/application/editor/CMakeLists.txt, where it invokes bash. I used a temporary CTest manifest and Windows batch runner with the same VIXEN_SIMULATE_DEVICE_LOSS=40 and VIXEN_EXIT_AFTER_FRAMES=85 contract; the native stress then passed 1/1. Add a native Windows registration or runner for this scenario so native recovery verification does not need lane-local test glue.
